title: Animal exploitation and meat consumption model: Archaeozoological analysis of osteological materials from the LBK settlement
version: Ludwinowo, site 7: Neolithic settlement in Kuyavia, chapter 7.1, DOI 10.33547/ODA-SAH.08.Lud.07.1.
lineage: Original zooarchaeological report on bones and teeth, distinct specimens and authors from the sherd lipid study.

passages.note: Cattle predominate in the Early Neolithic faunal assemblage. The authors infer livestock exploitation for meat and secondary products; small ruminants may have supplied milk too.
